in_marathi.name: Amita
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘amrita’, meaning immortal or imperishable. In Hindu mythology, Amita is a name given to goddesses representing various aspects of the divine. The goddess Amitabha is a central figure in Mahayana Buddhism, known for her boundless compassion and the promise of enlightenment to all sentient beings.
